record.rationale: Adapts dirty Writer shell generations to ODT IndexedDB saves and refuses empty documents. This boundary is browser-owned and has no direct native LibreOffice counterpart; Writer model semantics stay in the core modules.
responsibilities: Adapts dirty Writer shell generations to ODT IndexedDB saves and refuses empty documents.

TaskFJTKAS extracts the existing Writer complete-package IndexedDB store,title uniqueness and autosave cadence into format-neutral framework/browser owners. Writer adapters retain the database vite-office-writer-workbench and10second interval,1second idle,30second maximum delay,input/capture handling,primary byte storage and no recovery copies. The shared scheduler receives suite-owned dirty/content,save,failure and subscription callbacks;it owns no document model. Calc uses the same storage transactions and timing policy with a separate suite database. This is an intentional browser persistence adaptation,not native AutoRecovery parity.

stackDivergence.rationale: Deliberate browser document lifecycle policy differs from upstream AutoRecovery and native file menus.
